matter_background.original: Mr. Alfred Perera purchased a property in Pannipitiya in January 1978 for Rs.160,000/-. He constructed a house on the property spending Rs.900,000/- and now the property is valued at Rs.9,000,000/-. He intends to gift this property to his daughter Himall.
